# KRT store

URL: https://krt.design/
Premium plugins, templates, design systems, icon packs and learning kits for designers and engineers. Free extras: swatches, starters, guides and snippets.

## Store

URL: https://krt.design/store/

## Products

### Clarity — Accessibility
URL: https://krt.design/store/clarity-plugin/
One-click accessibility audits for live URLs and design files.

### Pivot — Editor tool
URL: https://krt.design/store/pivot-extension/
Jump between files, symbols, and references without leaving the keyboard.

### Composer — Workflow
URL: https://krt.design/store/composer-plugin/
Generate Tailwind CSS component files from design tokens automatically.

### Atlas — Blog starter
URL: https://krt.design/store/atlas-template/
An Astro blog template with editorial rhythm and zero config.

### Arcwise — SaaS starter
URL: https://krt.design/store/arcwise-template/
A Next.js SaaS landing template with pricing, auth, and payments.

### Calm Tokens — Token pack
URL: https://krt.design/store/calm-tokens/
A neutral gray design token set for premium dark-mode interfaces.

### Frontline UI — Component library
URL: https://krt.design/store/frontline-ui/
React components with glass surfaces, motion, and Gumroad-style actions.

### Monochrome — Icon family
URL: https://krt.design/store/monochrome-icons/
320 monotone SVG icons for UI, dashboards, and marketing pages.

### Open Lesson Kit — Course starter
URL: https://krt.design/store/open-lesson-kit/
An Astro course template with video embeds, progress, and quizzes.

### Editor Shield — Content safety
URL: https://krt.design/store/editor-shield/
Auto-save, version snapshots, and offline recovery for browser editors.

### Dash UI Kit — Dashboard system
URL: https://krt.design/store/dash-ui-kit/
A complete dashboard design system with charts, tables, and sidebars.

### Trailhead — Release notes
URL: https://krt.design/store/trailhead-template/
A change-log and release-notes template with RSS and categories.
